items.title: Effects of Clear Aligner Therapy on Quality of Life and Anxiety Levels: An Exploratory Study in Patients With Disabilities.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Considering the orthodontic needs of individuals with disabilities and the potential impact of such treatments on both quality of life (QoL) and anxiety, this study aims to assess the effects of using clear aligner therapy (Invisalign) on QoL and anxiety levels in this population.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Fourteen patients with malocclusion and disabilities were enrolled. Initial orthodontic examinations were performed, and questionnaires were administered to assess QoL and anxiety using the WHOQoL-BREF and the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI-T), respectively, with assessments completed at baseline (T0), three months (T1), and six months (T2) after the start of therapy. The maximum sampling error was evaluated using Pearson's Coefficient of Variation. The normality of the sample distributions was assessed using the Shapiro-Wilk test. For within-group comparisons across the three time points, Friedman's nonparametric test for paired samples was employed, with a post hoc 2-to-2 Pairwise Comparison test. The correlation between QoL and anxiety levels was evaluated with Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (p < 0.05).
RESULTS: A statistically significant decrease was observed in the Environment domain at T2 compared to T0 and T1 (p = 0.0126), as well as a significant increase in the Overall Quality of Life domain from T1 to T2 (p = 0.0145). The correlation analysis revealed significant associations among the domains of the WHOQoL-BREF and STAI-T.
CONCLUSIONS: An improvement in the overall quality of life among children and adolescents with disabilities was observed during clear aligner therapy; nonetheless, further controlled studies are needed to confirm this association.
items.authors: Micheletti-Cerqueira Kelly Regina, Inagaki-Nomura Luciana Tiemi, Nagata Mariana Emi, de Oliveira Lima Carlos Eduardo, Tondelli Pedro Marcelo, de Araújo Fonseca Figueiredo Mariane, Brancher João Armando
items.summary_ja: 知的・身体的障害を有する不正咬合患者14名を対象に、クリアアライナー治療（Invisalign）が生活の質（QoL）と不安レベルに与える影響を評価した探索的研究。WHOQoL-BREFとSTAI-Tを用い、治療開始時（T0）、3ヶ月後（T1）、6ヶ月後（T2）の3時点での評価を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 障害を有する小児・思春期患者において、クリアアライナー治療中に全体的な生活の質の改善が観察された。Environment領域はT2でT0・T1と比較して有意に低下（p=0.0126）、Overall Quality of Life領域はT1からT2で有意に上昇（p=0.0145）した。WHOQoL-BREF各領域とSTAI-Tの間に有意な関連が認められた。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：障害を有する患者における不安レベル（STAI-T）の追跡が治療中の安全性評価に寄与する。ワークフローの観点：T0/T1/T2の構造化された評価プロトコルは、特殊な患者群における治療モニタリングのワークフロー設計に参考となる。
items.study_type_ja: 探索的前向き観察研究（反復測定デザイン）
items.endpoints_ja: 生活の質（WHOQoL-BREF各領域）、不安レベル（STAI-T）をT0、T1、T2の3時点で評価
items.endpoint_results_ja: Environment領域：T2がT0・T1と比較して有意に低下（p=0.0126）。Overall Quality of Life領域：T1からT2で有意に上昇（p=0.0145）。WHOQoL-BREF各領域とSTAI-Tの間に有意な関連が認められた。

items.title: Unexpected complications of long-term fixed retainers: A case series.
items.abstract: Unwanted tooth movements caused by long-term bonded fixed retainer placement or improperly placed orthodontic appliances can cause adverse occlusal and periodontal effects. This case series reports the treatment of severe complications of long-term fixed retention in two previously orthodontically treated adult patients. Both patients wore a mandibular canine-to-canine bonded retainer, with no evident signs of debonding or breakage; however, the mandibular incisor, which had remained bonded to the retainer, was bearing the entire incisor load, resulting in extreme lingual movement of the root, and ultimately severe lingual fenestration. In both patients the treatment opted for was carefully designed customized appliances comprising clear aligners in one case and a fully customized lingual fixed appliance in the other, to recover proper alignment, with labial repositioning of the displaced roots. The treatment outcomes were satisfactory, and lingual gingival recession appeared resolved in both patients, as confirmed by pre- and post-treatment CBCT. The treatment and clinical manifestations initially observed are discussed, along with the possible causes and considerations for the prevention of similar clinical scenarios.
items.authors: Mampieri Gianluca, Scuzzo Giacomo, Giancotti Aldo
items.summary_ja: 長期固定保装置による重大な合併症を呈した2名の成人患者の症例シリーズ。両患者とも下顎犬歯間ボンド型固定保装置を装着しており、デボンドや破損の所見はなかったが、下顎切歯が保装置にボンドされたまま切歯荷重を全て負担し、歯根の極端な舌側移動と重度の舌側穿通（fenestration）をきたした。治療には、1例ではクリアアライナー、もう1例ではフルカスタマイズされた舌側固定装置を用い、歯根の唇側再位置と咬合回復を目的とした。治療成績は満足可であり、術前後CBCTで舌側歯肉退縮の解決が確認された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 固定保装置がデボンドや破損なく intact に見える場合でも、力分布の不適切さにより重度の歯周合併症（舌側穿通）を来し得る。クリアアライナーやカスタマイズ舌側固定装置を用いた治療により、歯根の唇側再位置と歯肉退縮の解決が可能であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：保装置が外観上問題なく見える状態でも重度の歯周損傷を来し得ることを示し、保装置装着中の定期モニタリングの重要性を裏付ける。計画品質の観点：保装置の設計における力分布の考慮が不十分であったことが合併症の一要因であり、保装置計画時の生体力学的評価の重要性を示唆する。planned-vs-achievedの観点：保装置は計画通り装着・維持されていたが、意図しない重度の歯根移動という結果が生じた。
items.study_type_ja: 症例シリーズ（2例）
items.endpoints_ja: 治療成績（満足可否）、舌側歯肉退縮の解決（術前後CBCTによる確認）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に数値は記載されていない。定性的な記述のみ：「治療成績は満足可であり、両患者とも舌側歯肉退縮が解決したことが術前後CBCTで確認された」。

items.title: Evaluation of the preventive effects of fluoride varnish, CPP-ACP, nHAp, and self-assembling peptide P11-4 on enamel demineralization around and under clear aligner attachments: An in vitro study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: This study aimed to evaluate and compare the effects of fluoride varnish (FV), casein phosphopeptide-amorphous calcium phosphate (CPP-ACP), nano-hydroxyapatite (nHAp), and self-assembling peptide (SAP) P11-4 on the prevention of enamel demineralization around and under orthodontic clear aligner attachments.
METHODS: Ninety-six freshly extracted human premolar teeth were randomly assigned to six groups (n=16): FV, CPP-ACP, nHAp, SAP, positive control (CO+), and negative control (CO-). Attachments were bonded to the buccal surfaces of the teeth in the treatment groups. The positive control group received attachments without additional treatment. The negative control group received no attachment and was immersed only in deionized water. The remineralizing agents were then applied to the buccal surfaces of the teeth. All groups, except for the negative control group, were subjected to a pH-cycling process for 15 days. Each tooth was sectioned buccolingually; one half was utilized for cross-sectional microhardness (CSMH) testing and the other half for energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) analysis. Both tests were conducted at the occlusal, middle, and gingival areas of the attachment. Enamel CSMH and EDX calcium/phosphorus (Ca/P) ratio were assessed at multiple depths from the external enamel surface in each area. Statistical analysis was performed using a three-way mixed-design ANOVA and Games-Howell post hoc tests.
RESULTS: The group effect was significant for both CSMH (F(5,90)=123.8, P<0.001, partial η2=0.87) and the Ca/P ratio (F(5,90)=30.0, P<0.001, partial η2=0.63). SAP showed the highest values among the remineralizing agents (CSMH, 189.8, 95% confidence intervals [CI], 186.6-193.0; Ca/P, 2.13, 95% CI, 2.10-2.16). For CSMH, SAP values were significantly higher than those for nHAp and the positive control (p ≤ 0.002). Differences among SAP, FV, and CPP-ACP were not significant once within-tooth clustering was accounted for. For the Ca/P ratio, SAP values were significantly higher than those for FV, CPP-ACP, nHAp, and the positive control (P≤0.03). All agents showed significantly higher values than the positive control (P<0.02). CSMH and the Ca/P ratio increased with depth (P<0.001), and gingival values were lower than occlusal and middle values (P<0.001).
CONCLUSION: All tested remineralizing agents demonstrated variable preventive effects against enamel demineralization around and under clear aligner attachments when compared with the positive control group. SAP showed the most favourable results among all treatment groups.
items.authors: Hasan Ali Khalil, Kamel Ahmed Mohamed, Shamaa Marwa Sameh
items.summary_ja: クリアアライナーアタッチメント周囲および下面のエナメル質脱灰予防効果について、フッ化物バーニッシュ（FV）、CPP-ACP、ナノヒドロキシアパタイト（nHAp）、自己集合ペプチド（SAP）P11-4の効果を比較評価したin vitro研究。抜歯したヒト前臼歯96本を6群（各n=16）に無作為割り付けし、15日間のpHサイクル処理後に断層マイクロ硬さ（CSMH）およびCa/P比をアタッチメントの切端・中部・歯肉部で測定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SAP（P11-4）は、クリアアライナーアタッチメント周囲および下面のエナメル質脱灰予防において、全治療群中で最も良好な結果を示した。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：クリアアライナーアタッチメント周囲のエナメル質脱灰（ホワイトスポット病変）はアライナー治療の既知の臨床的懸念事項であり、本研究はアタッチメント周囲の脱灰予防に有効な再石灰化剤をin vitro条件下で比較したものであり、治療中の安全性管理に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: in vitro研究
items.endpoints_ja: 断層マイクロ硬さ（CSMH）、Ca/P比（アタッチメントの切端・中部・歯肉部、エナメル質外表面から複数深度で測定）
items.endpoint_results_ja: CSMH：群効果有意（F(5,90)=123.8, P<0.001, partial η2=0.87）。Ca/P比：群効果有意（F(5,90)=30.0, P<0.001, partial η2=0.63）。SAPのCSMHは189.8（95% CI 186.6-193.0）、Ca/P比は2.13（95% CI 2.10-2.16）で、再石灰化剤中最も高値。CSMHにおいてSAPはnHApおよび陽性対照より有意に高値（p≤0.002）。SAP、FV、CPP-ACP間の差は歯内クラスタリングを考慮すると有意でなかった。Ca/P比においてSAPはFV、CPP-ACP、nHAp、陽性対照より有意に高値（P≤0.03）。全薬剤が陽性対照より有意に高値（P<0.02）。CSMHおよびCa/P比は深度とともに増加（P<0.001）、歯肉部は切端部・中部より低値（P<0.001）。

items.title: A retrospective study of mandibular incisor intrusion with invisalign in adult deep-bite patients.
items.abstract: This retrospective study quantitatively evaluated mandibular incisor intrusion and associated vertical skeletal changes during deep-bite correction using Invisalign clear aligner therapy. Twenty-seven adult patients (19-54 years of age) with skeletal Class I or II malocclusion and deep overbite (> 3 mm) treated with Invisalign incorporating precision bite ramps were retrospectively analyzed. Lateral cephalometric radiographs obtained before (T0) and after treatment (T1) were superimposed on the cranial base and mandible. Mandibular incisor movement was assessed using centroid-based measurements to isolate pure intrusion and minimize the influence of tipping. Changes in the occlusal plane angle, mandibular plane angle (FMA), incisor mandibular plane angle (IMPA), and molar vertical position were also evaluated. Paired t-tests were performed for statistical comparisons. The mandibular incisor centroid demonstrated statistically significant pure intrusion of 1.63 mm (p < 0.001). Occlusal plane angle increased significantly (mean change: 2.38°, p = 0.001) and overbite decreased (mean change: -1.98 mm, p = 0.001), whereas changes in the FMA, IMPA, and mandibular molar extrusion were not statistically significant, suggesting limited vertical skeletal changes during treatment. These findings suggest that Invisalign therapy with precision bite ramps demonstrated mandibular incisor intrusion in adult deep-bite patients.
items.authors: Choo Hyunhee, Kim Young Ho, Chang Kunyoung, Hong Pureum, Kim Minseo, Kim Soo Jin, Shin Jeong Won, Ji Hyeok
items.summary_ja: Invisalign透明アライナー治療（precision bite ramps併用）による成人deep-bite症例の顎下前歯圧入および関連する垂直骨格変化を定量的に評価した後ろ向き研究。骨格Class IまたはIIの不正咬合でdeep overbite（>3 mm）を有する成人27例（19〜54歳）を対象に、治療前（T0）と治療後（T1）の側面頭部X線写真を頭蓋底および下顎に重ね合わせ、重心ベースの測定により純粋な圧入を分離評価した。咬合平面角、FMA、IMPA、下顎臼歯の垂直位置の変化も評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Precision bite rampsを併用したInvisalign治療は、成人deep-bite症例で顎下前歯の統計的に有意な純粋圧入（1.63 mm）を達成し、咬合平面角の増加（+2.38°）とoverbiteの減少（-1.98 mm）を伴ったが、FMA・IMPA・下顎臼歯の圧出には統計的有意な変化はなく、治療中の垂直骨格変化は限定的であった。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：precision bite rampsという特定機能を用いた際の実際の圧入量（1.63 mm）が定量化されており、治療計画時の期待値設定に参考となる。planning qualityの観点：重心ベース測定による純粋圧入とtipの分離評価手法は、治療計画の精度評価に有用。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き研究（retrospective study）
items.endpoints_ja: 顎下前歯の純粋圧入量（重心ベース）、咬合平面角の変化、overbiteの変化、FMAの変化、IMPAの変化、下顎臼歯の垂直位置（圧出）の変化
items.endpoint_results_ja: 顎下前歯純粋圧入：1.63 mm（p < 0.001）、咬合平面角：+2.38°（p = 0.001）、overbite：-1.98 mm（p = 0.001）、FMA：統計的に有意な変化なし、IMPA：統計的に有意な変化なし、下顎臼歯圧出：統計的に有意な変化なし

items.title: Evaluation of Antibacterial Effect and Mechanical Properties of Thermoformed Clear Aligners Coated with Chitosan and Cellulose Nanocrystals.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Though aligners are considered more hygienic, they are linked to a higher occurrence of white spot lesions. These lesions pose clinical challenges and compromise aesthetics.
PURPOSE: The aim of present study was the evaluation of antibacterial effect and mechanical properties of thermoformed clear aligners coated with chitosan and cellulose nanocrystals.
MATERIALS AND METHOD: This in vitro study evaluated five experimental groups of aligners including (1) Passive control, (2) Active control, (3) Aligners coated with chitosan (CH), (4) Aligners coated with cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs), and (5) Aligners coated with a combination of CH/CNCs. Each group consisted of 30 samples that consisted of 10 discs for antimicrobial testing, 5 cubes for surface microhardness, and 15 cubes for the three-point bending test. Surface morphology was analyzed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS). Antibacterial properties were assessed through disc diffusion and serial dilution methods against Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Streptococcus mutans (S. mutans). Mechanical properties, including surface microhardness and maximum force under bending, were evaluated using Vickers hardness and three-point bending tests. Statistical analysis was performed using ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis tests, with p Value< 0.05 considered significant.
RESULTS: The CH/CNC group showing the highest microhardness (13.37±1.00 VHN) and the CNC group demonstrated the highest force resistance (62.31±7.36 MPa), though the difference was not statistically significant (p> 0.05). In the disc diffusion test, CH coatings showed significant antibacterial activity, especially against E. coli (10.8±1.09mm zone of inhibition, p= 0.006), and while CH/CNC showed significant antibacterial activity, especially against S. mutans (6.00±5.47, p= 0.020). CNC coatings showed no bacterial inhibitory effect (p> 0.05).
CONCLUSION: The results of our study suggested that applying CNC combined with chitosan as coatings on orthodontic aligners offers a viable strategy to improve both antimicrobial and mechanical properties.
items.authors: Hosseini Seyyed Hadi, Motamedifar Mohammad, Ajami Shabnam
items.summary_ja: 熱成形型クリアアライナーにキトサン（CH）とセルロースナノクリスタル（CNC）をコーティングした5群（パッシブ対照、アクティブ対照、CHコーティング、CNCコーティング、CH/CNC複合コーティング）について、抗菌効果と機械的性質をin vitroで評価した研究。抗菌性はE. coliとS. mutansに対するディスク拡散法と連続希釈法で、機械的性質は表面マイクロ硬さ（ビッカース硬さ）と3点曲げ試験で評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CH/CNC複合コーティング群が最も高いマイクロ硬さ（13.37±1.00 VHN）を示し、CNC群が最も高い曲げ耐 lực（62.31±7.36 MPa）を示したが、群間差は統計的に有意ではなかった（p>0.05）。抗菌性ではCHコーティングがE. coliに対して有意な抗菌活性（10.8±1.09mm、p=0.006）を示し、CH/CNC複合コーティングがS. mutansに対して有意な抗菌活性（6.00±5.47、p=0.020）を示した。CNC単独コーティングには抗菌効果は認められなかった（p>0.05）。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：アライナー使用に伴うホワイトスポット病変の発生は臨床的課題であり、抗菌コーティングによる細菌付着抑制は患者の口腔健康リスク低減に寄与し得る。planned-vs-achievedの観点：アライナー材料の機械的性質（硬さ・曲げ耐性）は力伝達の一貫性に影響し、治療計画通りの歯移動が達成されるかどうかに関わる材料特性として関連する。
items.study_type_ja: in vitro研究（材料評価・ベンチスタディ）
items.endpoints_ja: 抗菌活性（ディスク拡散法による阻害環直径）、表面マイクロ硬さ（ビッカース硬さ）、3点曲げ試験による最大曲げ力、表面形態（SEM・EDS）
items.endpoint_results_ja: CH/CNC群：マイクロ硬さ 13.37±1.00 VHN（最高値）。CNC群：曲げ耐力 62.31±7.36 MPa（最高値）。群間差は統計的に有意でない（p>0.05）。CHコーティング：E. coliに対する阻害環 10.8±1.09mm（p=0.006、有意）。CH/CNC複合コーティング：S. mutansに対する阻害環 6.00±5.47（p=0.020、有意）。CNCコーティング：抗菌効果なし（p>0.05）。

items.title: Nonsurgical clear aligner treatment of an adult right-sided Class III subdivision malocclusion using miniscrew-assisted mandibular distalization: A case report.
items.abstract: Adult asymmetric Class III malocclusions can be challenging to camouflage when crowding, anterior crossbite, and dental midline discrepancies must be corrected without worsening an acceptable soft-tissue profile. This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with mild skeletal Class III malocclusion mainly due to maxillary retrusion, a normodivergent pattern, a right-sided Class III subdivision associated with leftward mandibular deviation, mild crowding in both arches, an edge-to-edge incisor relationship, and noncoincident dental midlines. After extraction of all third molars, treatment was performed with Invisalign Comprehensive aligners, staged interproximal enamel reduction, programmed maxillary incisor extrusion, and asymmetric mandibular distalization of up to 2.0mm on the right and 1.3mm on the left. Two posterior mandibular miniscrews were connected to composite buttons on the mandibular canines to reinforce distal traction, and a right-sided Class III elastic was added during refinement. A refinement-related posterior open bite was managed with posterior aligner cutback and vertical settling elastics. Active treatment lasted 21 months. Bilateral Class I canine and molar relationships, coincident dental midlines, positive overjet and overbite, correction of the anterior crossbite, and improved maxillary incisor display were achieved. Cephalometric changes were predominantly dentoalveolar, with maintenance of the skeletal pattern, mandibular incisor retraction, and lower-lip retrusion. Miniscrew anchorage was essential in combination with aligners, interproximal reduction, attachments, and elastics. The occlusion and periodontal condition remained stable at the 1-year follow-up.
items.authors: Nguyen Viet Anh, Doan Thi Bich Ngoc, Ha Phuong Linh, Nguyen Thi Nhu Trang
items.summary_ja: 40歳の女性で、上顎後退を主因とする軽度骨格性Class III不正咬合、右側Class III subdivision、両顎の軽度叢生、エッジトゥエッジ切歯関係、歯軸中線不一致を呈した症例。全第三大臼歯抜去後、Invisalign Comprehensiveアライナー、段階的IPR、上顎切歯のプログラムされた圧排、右側最大2.0mm・左側1.3mmの非対称下顎遠心移動（後方下顎ミニスクリュー2本を犬歯のコンポジットボタンに連結して遠心牽引を強化）により治療。精査段階で生じた後方オープンバイトは後方アライナーカットバックと垂直方向セッティングエラстикで管理。主治療期間は21ヶ月。両側Class I犬歯・臼歯関係、歯軸中線一致、正のオーバージェット・オーバーバイト、前歯交叉咬合の修正、上顎切歯露出の改善を達成。頭部X線計測所見は主に歯槽骨性変化であり、骨格パターンは維持された。1年後フォローアップで咬合および歯周状態は安定。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 複雑なClass III subdivision症例における非対称下顎遠心移動には、アライナー・IPR・アタッチメント・エラстикとの組み合わせにおいてミニスクリューアンカレッジが不可欠であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 精査（refinement）段階で後方オープンバイトが発生し、アライナーカットバックと垂直方向セッティングエラстикで対応した事例として、精査フェーズの計画品質管理に示唆を与える。また、計画された非対称遠心移動量（右2.0mm・左1.3mm）と達成された咬合結果（両側Class I関係、中線一致）の対応関係が示されており、planned-vs-achievedの観点で参考となる。1年後の歯周安定性は安全性の観点からも意義がある。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告
items.endpoints_ja: 咬合結果（犬歯・臼歯関係、オーバージェット、オーバーバイト、歯軸中線）、頭部X線計測変化、1年後の咬合・歯周安定性
items.endpoint_results_ja: 非対称下顎遠心移動：右側最大2.0mm、左側1.3mm。主治療期間21ヶ月。両側Class I犬歯・臼歯関係、歯軸中線一致、正のオーバージェット・オーバーバイトを達成。頭部X線計測変化は主に歯槽骨性。1年後フォローアップで咬合および歯周状態は安定。

items.title: Do resin composite type and bleaching regimen influence tooth color change under attachment presence? An in vitro study.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the influence of composite resin type used for attachment fabrication and of bleaching regimen on the colour and whiteness changes of bovine enamel submitted to bleaching.
METHODS: Standardized crowns received attachments made with Voco AlignerFlow LC (AF), 3M™ Transbond™ Supreme LV, (LV), or were left without attachment (WA). Specimens were treated with at-home (HO), in-office (OF), or without bleaching (WB). Therefore, nine groups were established (n=10/group): AF/HO, AF/OF, AF/WB, LV/HO, LV/OF, LV/WB, WA/HO, WA/OF, and WA/WB. Color (ΔE00), whiteness index (ΔWID), and colour coordinates (ΔL*, Δa*, Δb*) changes were evaluated by means of digital spectrophotometry. Data were analysed using generalized linear models followed by Bonferroni tests (α=5%).
RESULTS: AF/HO and AF/OF showed similar ΔE00 and ΔWID (P=1.000), both being higher than AF/WB (P<0.05). For the LV resin, only LV/OF differed from LV/WB for ΔE00 (P=0.044) and ΔWID (P=0.018), whereas LV/HO and LV/OF showed similar ΔWID (P=0.998). In the absence of attachments, WA/HO and WA/OF exhibited higher ΔE00 and ΔWID than WA/WB (both P<0.001). Specimens without attachments showed higher ΔE00, ΔWID, and Δb* than those with AF or LV attachments (all P<0.05). All bleached groups exceed the perceptibility and acceptability thresholds for both ΔE00 and ΔWID, whereas WA/WB remained below these thresholds.
CONCLUSION: The presence of attachments reduced bleaching effectiveness and compromised colour uniformity, although bleaching remained effective compared to non-bleached conditions. No differences were observed between at-home and in-office protocols, and the type of attachment resin composite also did not interfere in the outcomes.

items.summary_ja: 牛歯エナメル質を用いたin vitro研究であり、アタッチメント作製に使用したコンポジットレジンタイプ（Voco AlignerFlow LC、3M Transbond Supreme LV、アタッチメントなし）とホワイトニングプロトコル（ホームホワイトニング、オフィスホワイトニング、ホワイトニングなし）が色および白さの変化に与える影響を評価した。9群（各群n=10）を設け、デジタル分光光度計によりΔE00、ΔWID、色座標（ΔL*、Δa*、Δb*）の変化を測定した。

items.title: Thirty-Day Thermomechanical Ageing of 3D-Printed and Thermoformed Orthodontic Aligners: A Comparative Force Analysis.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To investigate the effect of thermomechanical ageing on the force system of three-dimensional (3D)-printed orthodontic aligners compared with conventional thermoformed aligners and to evaluate the thickness characteristics of both aligner types.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Ten aligners were fabricated from 3D-printed Tera Harz TC-85 resin, and 10 from thermoformed Zendura FLX (ZF). All aligners underwent thermomechanical ageing for up to 30 days. Forces transmitted to the maxillary right central incisor (Tooth 11) in a resin model were measured before ageing (Day 0) and after thermomechanical ageing (Days 2, 7, and 30) using Fuji pressure-sensitive films to assess contact normal forces and an orthodontic measurement and simulation system (OMSS) to measure resultant 3D forces. Aligner thickness was evaluated using a digital caliper and microcomputed tomography.
RESULTS: TC-85 aligners generated significantly higher initial normal contact forces than ZF aligners (149.7 ± 25.6 N vs 69.8 ± 9.0 N). Both materials exhibited significant force decay following thermomechanical ageing. Orthodontic measurement and simulation system analysis demonstrated comparable preageing resultant forces for both materials (0.1 ± 0.07 N to 0.5 ± 0.09 N), with no statistically significant difference in facial force components at baseline. Facial forces remained relatively stable over time, whereas lingual resultant forces decreased significantly. Thickness analysis demonstrated pronounced thinning in ZF aligners (≈0.5 ± 0.05 mm) and thickening in TC-85 aligners (≈1.0 ± 0.09 mm).
CONCLUSIONS: TC-85 aligners produced higher initial normal contact forces than ZF aligners, consistent with their greater postmanufacturing thickness and reported improved adaptation to the dental model; however, both materials exhibited force decay over time. Although preageing resultant forces were comparable between materials, the reduction in lingual resultant forces may adversely affect the predictability of tooth movement during prolonged aligner wear.
CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE: The current findings underscore the significant impact of aligner material, thickness, and manufacturing method on force stability and consistency in clear aligner therapy.
items.authors: Elshazly Tarek, Alhotan Abdulaziz, Shalabi Ammar Al, Elshennawy Ahmad, Diraz Hala, Puchert Kathrin, Kim Hoon, Talaat Sameh
items.summary_ja: 3Dプリント（TC-85レジン）と熱成形（Zendura FLX）の矯正アライナーについて、30日間の熱機械的経時変化が力系に与える影響を比較し、両アライナーの厚さ特性を評価したin vitro比較研究。上顎右側中切歯（Tooth 11）への伝達力をDay 0、2、7、30日にFuji圧感紙とOMSSで測定し、厚さはデジタルノギスとマイクロCTで評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: TC-85アライナーはZFアライナーより有意に高い初期接触法線力を生じた（149.7±25.6 N vs 69.8±9.0 N）が、両材料とも経時変化により力減衰を示した。特に舌側合成力が有意に減少し、長時間アライナー装着時の歯移動の予測可能性に悪影響を与える可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 舌側合成力の経時的減少は、長時間アライナー装着時の歯移動の予測可能性（planned vs achieved）に悪影響を与える可能性が示唆されている。安全性: アライナー材料・厚さ・製造方法が力の安定性と一貫性に大きな影響を与えることが確認され、治療計画時の材料選択の根拠となる。

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Transverse Maxillary Arch Changes in Mixed Dentition with Clear Aligners vs Conventional Maxillary Expanders: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate and compare the effects of clear aligner therapy (CAT) vs conventional maxillary expanders [rapid maxillary expansion (RME) and slow maxillary expansion (SME)] in treating maxillary arch constriction during mixed dentition with a focus on transverse arch parameters, including intercanine and intermolar widths, molar inclination, arch perimeter, and palatal depth.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Electronic searches of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Medline upto August 2025 identified 341 records. Studies included randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and prospective and retrospective cohorts assessing ME outcomes with clear aligners and conventional RME/SME expanders in mixed dentition patients. Outcomes included intercanine width, intermolar width, arch perimeter, arch width and depth, molar inclination, and palatal volume. Risk of bias was evaluated using the revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials (RoB 2) for RCTs and the Methodological Index for Nonrandomized Studies (MINORS) for nonrandomized studies.
RESULTS: Eight studies met inclusion criteria, comprising a total of 412 patients aged 8.4 ± 1.3 years. Meta-analysis showed a significant trend favoring maxillary expanders over CAT for both intercanine width expansion [-0.54; 95% confidence interval (CI): -1.17, 0.09; p = 0.09] and intermolar width [-1.01 (95% CI: -1.59, -0.43; p = 0.0006)]. CAT demonstrated superior control over molar inclination with reduced buccal tipping. Heterogeneity varied across outcomes, largely owing to differences in study designs and protocols. Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) assessment revealed overall very low quality of evidence with moderate risk of bias.
CONCLUSION: RME demonstrated significantly greater increases in intermolar width compared to CAT, while intercanine width changes were comparable between treatments. Although both modalities effectively address transverse deficiencies in mixed dentition, they differ in expansion patterns and dental effects, with CAT offering more controlled dentoalveolar expansion and minimal molar tipping.
HOW TO CITE THIS ARTICLE: Athawale S, Mohelay N, Batra P, et al. Comparative Evaluation of Transverse Maxillary Arch Changes in Mixed Dentition with Clear Aligners vs Conventional Maxillary Expanders: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis. Int J Clin Pediatr Dent 2026;19(8):1067-1077.

items.summary_ja: 混合歯列期における上顎横径拡大に対し、クリアアライナー（CAT）と従来の上顎拡大装置（RME/SME）の効果を比較したシステマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス。8研究・412例（平均年齢8.4±1.3歳）を対象に、犬歯間幅、大臼歯間幅、歯弓周囲長、歯弓幅・深さ、大臼歯傾斜、口蓋体積を評価した。メタアナリシスでは、大臼歯間幅の拡大においてRMEがCATに有意に優位（-1.01; 95%CI: -1.59, -0.43; p=0.0006）であり、犬歯間幅は両群間で有意差なし（-0.54; 95%CI: -1.17, 0.09; p=0.09）。CATは歯槽骨性拡大の制御性が高く、大臼歯の頬側傾斜が少なかった。GRADE評価では全体的に非常に低い質のエビデンス、中等度のバイアスリスクと判定された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 混合歯列期の横径拡大において、大臼歯間幅の拡大効果はRMEがCATに有意に優位である一方、犬歯間幅は同等。CATは歯槽骨性拡大の制御性が高く大臼歯傾斜が少ないが、横径拡大の絶対量ではRMEに劣る。エビデンスの質は非常に低く、臨床判断には注意が必要。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：CATによる横径拡大の達成量はRMEより小さい（特に大臼歯間幅）ため、治療計画時にCAT単独での横径拡大目標を設定する場合は、期待される拡大量に上限があることを認識する必要がある。refinementの観点：CATは歯槽骨性拡大の制御性が高く大臼歯の頬側傾斜が少ないため、歯の移動パターンを精密に制御したい症例ではCATの特性が計画の質に影響する。ただし、エビデンスの質が非常に低いため、計画時の信頼度は限定的。

items.title: The Environmental Burden and Sustainability Challenges of Clear Aligners: Implications for Public Health, Practice, Policy, and Future Research-A Scoping Review.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Malocclusion is a major global oral health concern and has driven the rapid adoption of clear aligner therapy (CAT) as an esthetic and removable alternative to conventional fixed appliances. However, the widespread use of CAT has raised important concerns regarding its environmental footprint and potential public health implications, including waste generation, chemical leaching, and the release of microplastics. This scoping review aimed to systematically synthesize the available evidence on the environmental and public health implications of CAT and identify key areas in practice, research, and policy to advance toward sustainable oral healthcare services in alignment with the World Health Organization's Global Oral Health Action Plan 2023-2030.
METHODS: This scoping review was conducted in accordance with Arksey and O'Malley's framework and reported in line with PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Eligible sources were identified through a search across four databases, namely, PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Embase, to identify literature addressing environmental or public health aspects of clear aligners, published in English, either in print or online ahead of print, between January 2005 and December 2025. Data charting was conducted, followed by qualitative analysis using ATLAS.ti to identify the key themes emerging from included sources relating to the research question.
RESULTS: A total of 61 sources were included. The major themes which emerged from this scoping review included material toxicity and chemical exposure, microplastic and nanoplastic release, environmental burden of CAT, technological transitions in the form of 3D/4D aligners, strategies toward sustainability and governance, regulation, and research gaps.
CONCLUSIONS: CAT must be recognized not only as an orthodontic innovation but also as an emerging public health and sustainability challenge, highlighting the need for stronger evidence, safer materials, improved waste management, and clearer regulations to align future orthodontic care with Sustainable Development Goals 3 (Good Health and Well-being) and 13 (Climate Action).

items.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正（CAT）の環境負荷と持続可能性に関するスコーピングレビュー。廃棄物発生、化学物質溶出、マイクロプラスチック放出などの公衆衛生上の懸念を体系的に統合し、WHOグローバルオーラルヘルス行動計画2023-2030に沿った持続可能な口腔医療サービスへの課題を特定することを目的とした。Arksey and O'Malleyのフレームワークに従い、PRISMA-ScRガイドラインに沿って報告。PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Embaseの4データベースから2005年1月から2025年12月までに英語で出版された文献を抽出し、ATLAS.tiを用いて定性分析を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CATは正畸学的イノベーションであると同時に、新興の公衆衛生・持続可能性上の課題であり、より強力なエビデンス、より安全な材料、改善された廃棄物管理、明確な規制が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：材料毒性・化学物質曝露、マイクロプラスチック・ナノプラスチック放出が主要テーマとして特定されており、CATの安全性プロファイルに関する公衆衛生上の懸念が示唆されている。

items.title: Antibacterial Interventions for Orthodontic Appliances; Surface Modifications, Coatings and Bulk-Incorporated Antibacterial Agents: Materials, Mechanisms and Clinical Application-A Scoping Review.
items.abstract: Biofilm accumulation on orthodontic appliances is a recognized risk factor for white spot lesion formation and caries during treatment. Antibacterial surface modifications and coating strategies have been proposed as appliance-level preventive approaches. Studied interventions in the literature span true thin-film surface coatings, plasma-based and ion-implantation surface modifications, and bulk-incorporated antibacterial agents in appliance matrix materials. Yet the extent to which in vitro efficacy translates to clinically meaningful protection remains unresolved. This PRISMA-ScR-compliant scoping review searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar, identifying 109 eligible studies: 96 in vitro, 8 in vivo animal studies and 5 clinical trials, covering brackets, archwires, clear aligners, bands, miniscrews, elastomeric ligatures, and removable appliances, some articles studied multiple types of appliances. In vitro studies consistently demonstrated significant reductions in bacterial adhesion and biofilm formation across all appliance types, with silver-based coatings and nitrogen-doped TiO2 showing the broadest evidence base; combination systems (Ag/ZnO, CuO-ZnO) outperformed individual agents. The 13 in vivo and clinical studies provided limited but directionally supportive evidence: silver nanoparticle-incorporated acrylic retainers reduced S. mutans counts in a double-blind RCT, and silver-infiltrated tungsten material-maintained biofilm reduction after simulated two-year abrasion. Coating durability emerged as an important determinant of potential clinical translation. Surface-deposited thin-film coatings degraded substantially within one month of intraoral use, whereas substrate-integrated approaches showed greater longevity. This scoping review maps the current evidence landscape, identifies coating durability and clinical endpoint validation as critical gaps, and prioritizes silver-based and nitrogen-doped TiO2 coatings for future randomized clinical trials.
items.authors: Furió-Alonso Berta, Gil Javier, Nikolic Jovanovic Danica, Puigdollers-Pérez Andreu
items.summary_ja: PRISMA-ScR準拠のスコーピングレビューであり、PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Google Scholarを検索し、109件の適格研究（in vitro 96件、in vivo動物実験8件、臨床試験5件）を特定した。ブラケット、アークワイヤー、クリアアライナー、バンド、ミニスクリュー、エラストマーリガチャー、可撤式装置を対象に、抗菌性表面改質・コーティング・マトリクス内分散型抗菌剤の証拠を整理した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: in vitro研究では全装置タイプで細菌付着・バイオフィルム形成の有意な減少が一貫して示されたが、in vivo・臨床研究（13件）は限定的であり、薄膜コーティングは口腔内使用1ヶ月以内に著しく劣化し、基質統合型アプローチの方が耐久性に優れることが示された。臨床転換の重要なギャップはコーティング耐久性と臨床エンドポイントの検証である。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：装置上のバイオフィルム蓄積は治療中のホワイトスポット病変形成と齲蝕の既知のリスク因子であり、クリアアライナーを含む装置レベルの予防戦略として抗菌コーティングが検討されている。ただし、薄膜コーティングが1ヶ月以内に劣化するという知見は、長期治療計画における持続的保護の観点から重要な制約条件となる。

items.title: Management of Skeletal Class II Malocclusion in a Growing Patient Using Clear Aligners and Class II Elastics: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Objective: Class II malocclusion with mandibular retrusion in growing patients is traditionally managed with functional appliances. Recent advances in clear aligner therapy have introduced new biomechanical approaches combining aligners with intermaxillary elastics. This case report describes the correction of a skeletal Class II malocclusion using clear aligners combined with Class II elastics during the pubertal growth spurt. Methods: An 11-year-old female patient with skeletal Class II due to mandibular retrusion, increased overjet, deep bite, and dental Class II relationship was treated with clear aligners, transverse expansion, bite ramps, attachments, and full-time Class II elastics. Results: After 24 months of treatment, favorable dentoskeletal and occlusal outcomes were achieved, including improvement of the sagittal relationship (ANB reduction from 7° to 4°), mandibular advancement (SNB increase from 76° to 79°), and correction of overjet and overbite. Conclusions: The combination of clear aligners and Class II elastics may represent a valid treatment option for growing patients with mandibular Class II malocclusion, providing effective sagittal correction and good control of dental movements when applied during the appropriate growth phase.

items.title: A retrospective study of planned and achieved rotational changes of maxillary canines with clear aligner therapy.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: This retrospective study aimed to assess the accuracy of planned moderate-to-severe rotation changes (≥5°) of maxillary canines with the Invisalign (Align Technology, Tempe, Ariz) appliance. The secondary aim was to evaluate the influence of the planned rotation direction on the accuracy.
METHODS: Digital models representing the initial malocclusion, the planned occlusions, and the achieved occlusions after the wear of an initial series of Invisalign aligners by adult patients were measured using metrology software. A method to define rotation directions was formulated. The sample was then divided into 5 categories by rotation type: mesial-in, mesial-out, distal-in, distal-out, and combination rotations. This categorization enabled subsequent analyses to determine whether the planned rotation directions were met and whether rotation direction influenced accuracy.
RESULTS: A total of 114 maxillary canines from 75 patients satisfied the inclusion criteria. Overall, the mean accuracy of the planned rotation was 64%. Rotation direction had no statistically significant influence on the accuracy of the planned rotations. Planned rotation directions were achieved in 77% of the maxillary canines evaluated. Combination rotations demonstrated the greatest variability, with 51% rotating in a direction other than that planned. A 1° increase in rotational velocity per aligner correlated with a 5.35° shortfall in the accuracy of this rotation (P < 0.05).
CONCLUSIONS: The achieved rotation of maxillary canines after the wear of an initial series of Invisalign aligners differed from the planned movements in both magnitude and direction for planned rotations of ≥5°. A method for classifying rotation types was developed, which may facilitate further research to guide clinicians and optimize treatment outcomes.

items.title: Assessing the environmental impact of clear aligner therapy: a scoping review.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the environmental impact and sustainability-related practices of clear aligner therapy (CAT), focusing on environmental impact, economic implications, waste management, recycling practices, manufacturing processes, and aligner materials. It further explores the alignment of clear aligner practices with Sustainable Development Goals (SDG's) 3,9,12 and 13.
METHODOLOGY: A scoping review was conducted following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidelines. The review was guided by the Population-Concept-Context (PCC) framework. A comprehensive literature search was performed across five electronic databases (PubMed Central, Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, and EBSCOhost) for studies published between January 2014 and December 2024. Studies evaluating the environmental sustainability of clear aligner therapy, including materials, manufacturing processes, waste management, recycling practices, and carbon emissions, were included.
RESULTS: Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence indicates that clear aligner therapy contributes to plastic waste, microplastic generation, and greenhouse gas emissions throughout its life cycle. The included studies reported biodegradable materials, direct three-dimensional (3D) printing technologies (SDG-9), recycling initiatives (SDG 12), and circular economy approaches as potential strategies to reduce environmental impacts (SDG 3 & 13). However, the implementation of these strategies remains constrained by limited recycling infrastructure, economic considerations, and insufficient high-quality evidence.
CONCLUSION: Available evidence suggests that innovations in material selection, circular economy approaches, optimized manufacturing processes, and enhanced recycling programs may reduce the environmental burden associated with clear aligner therapy. Nevertheless, further high-quality environmental assessment studies are required to support the development of more sustainable orthodontic practices aligned with SDGs 3, 9, 12, and 13.

items.title: Impact of reducing aligners' wear schedule from 7-days to 3-days on the predictability of tooth movement and treatment efficiency: a randomized controlled trial.
items.abstract:
TRIAL DESIGN: This was a two-arm, parallel-group, single-blinded, single-center prospective randomized controlled trial conducted between October 2023 and March 2025.
PARTICIPANTS: Thirty-eight adults aged 18-30 years with Class I malocclusion and moderate-to-severe mandibular anterior crowding were included, recruited from a university orthodontic clinic. Forty-five participants were initially randomized; seven were excluded due to non-compliance.
INTERVENTIONS: Participants were randomly assigned to a 3-day aligner wear protocol with reduced activation (0.11 mm/1° per tray) or a conventional 7-day protocol (0.25 mm/2° per tray).
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the impact of reducing the aligner wear schedule from 7 days to 3 days on the predictability of linear and angular tooth movements for the mandibular incisors.
OUTCOME: The primary outcome was the deviation between predicted and achieved mandibular incisors' tooth movement following the first aligner series, assessed across three linear and three angular dimensions.
RANDOMIZATION: Participants were allocated using fixed block randomization with concealed sequentially numbered envelopes.
BLINDING: Outcome assessors were blinded to group allocation.
RESULTS: Linear deviations were comparable between groups and within the 0.5 mm ABO clinical threshold. Statistically significant angular deviations were observed for teeth 31 (p = 0.040) and 41 (p = 0.003), with additional significant buccolingual inclination for tooth 41 (p = 0.005); none exceeded the 2° clinical threshold. The 3-day group required significantly more refinement and clinical visits. No significant differences were observed in overall treatment duration or final occlusal outcomes. No adverse effects were reported.
CONCLUSIONS: While both protocols produced comparable occlusal outcomes, the 3-day protocol required more refinements and visits without improved predictability, suggesting wear duration plays a key role in aligner effectiveness.

items.title: A Comparison of Clear Aligners and Fixed Appliances in Orthodontic-Surgical Treatment of Non-Extraction Skeletal Class III Malocclusion.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: This retrospective study assessed the outcomes of combined orthodontic-surgical treatment in skeletal Class III patients by comparing results achieved with clear aligners to those achieved with conventional fixed appliances.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study involved 24 skeletal Class III malocclusion patients who were treated with non-extraction orthodontic using either fixed appliances or clear aligners (Invisalign), in conjunction with orthognathic surgery. All patients underwent mandibular surgery only. Lateral cephalometric radiographs were obtained and analysed for both groups at three stages: before orthodontic treatment (T0), one week before surgery (T1), and at least eight months after surgery (T2). All the statistical tests were performed in SPSS 30 and power calculations were done in G*Power.
RESULTS: In this pilot study, significant skeletal and dentoalveolar changes occurred in both groups (p < 0.001). Between-group comparisons showed that during presurgical decompensation (T1-T0), fixed appliances produced greater lower incisor proclination (IMPA) (p < 0.05, Cohen's d = -1.13 - 1.27). During postsurgical orthodontics (T2-T1), clear aligners resulted in less lower incisor labial tipping (L1-FH), less upper incisor intrusion (U1-PP), and less lower first molar intrusion (L6-MP) (p < 0.05, d = -1.03 - 1.1). At final follow-up (T2-T0), the clear aligner group continued to show less vertical intrusion of the lower incisor and first molar (L1-MP, L6-MP; p < 0.05, d = 1.11-1.17). After adjusting for genioplasty, clear aligners were associated with superior postsurgical vertical skeletal control, upper lip retraction, and facial convexity (p < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: Within this pilot study, clear aligners showed signals of greater treatment efficiency, less unwanted labial tipping, and reduced vertical intrusion, whereas fixed appliances showed greater incisor and molar decompensation. These hypothesis-generating findings indicate that treatment individualization by biomechanical needs and patient preferences should be tested in future powered trials.
LEVEL OF EVIDENCE III: This journal requires that authors assign a level of evidence to each article. For a full description of these Evidence-Based Medicine ratings, please refer to the Table of Contents or the online Instructions to Authors www.springer.com/00266 .

items.title: The predictability of clear aligner treatment in space opening for permanent maxillary lateral incisors: An observational retrospective cohort study.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Space opening with clear aligner therapy has been little researched. The aim of this retrospective observational study was to investigate the predictability of the Invisalign appliance (Align Technology, San José, Calif) in opening space for the permanent maxillary lateral incisor (PMLI).
METHODS: Data from Align Technology's digital treatment planning software system, ClinCheck (Align Technology, San Jose, Calif), were evaluated to determine the initial, predicted, and achieved space opening for the PMLI in patients satisfying the selection criteria. Acquisition of the relevant measurement values was performed using the Geomagic (3D Systems, Rock Hill, SC) metrology system. A mixed-effects model was used to account for within-patient dependence among tooth spaces and the 2 one-sided tests for equivalence testing and Bland-Altman analysis were employed.
RESULTS: Space opening for 41 PMLIs in 25 patients with a mean age of 21.2 ± 13.0 years was evaluated. Approximately 65.2%-69.8% of predicted space opening was achieved, with the mean differences between predicted and achieved values ranging from 0.9 ± 1.0 mm to 1.4 ± 1.2 mm (P <0.05). For patients <18 years of age, the mean difference between predicted and achieved canine angulation changes was 9.4 ± 9.1°, with 95% limits of agreement from -8.4° to +27.2° (P = 0.015). Mean differences between predicted and achieved canine angulation changes in patients ≥18 years of age (5.3 ± 6.4°) and central incisor angulation changes in patients <18 years of age (-0.1 ± 8.0°) and ≥18 years of age (-4.8 ± 7.6°) were not statistically significant.
CONCLUSIONS: The findings can help clinicians better understand the planning of space opening for PMLIs before clear aligner therapy commences and provide baseline information for future research.

items.title: Features of Aligners and Artificial Intelligence in Surgical-Orthodontic Protocol: A Narrative Communication.
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Dentofacial deformities require a multidisciplinary surgical-orthodontic protocol (SOP) in which orthodontic preparation, orthognathic surgery, postoperative finishing, and retention are closely coordinated to achieve stable functional and aesthetic outcomes. The increasing adoption of clear aligners, digital workflows, and artificial intelligence (AI) has profoundly modified this therapeutic pathway. This communication examines the role of clear-aligner therapy and AI throughout the contemporary surgical-orthodontic protocol, with particular emphasis on their integration into clinical practice. Discussion: From the surgical perspective, clear aligners provide treatment outcomes comparable to those achieved with conventional fixed appliances while offering greater predictability of treatment duration through digital treatment planning. However, their use requires careful management of specific clinical aspects, including surgical timing, intraoperative anchorage, postoperative dentoalveolar stabilisation, transverse dimension management, and retention, all of which demand close collaboration between the orthodontist and the maxillofacial surgeon. The communication also summarises current AI applications in orthodontics and orthognathic surgery, including automated cephalometric analysis, image segmentation, treatment-decision support, virtual patient construction, clear-aligner setup, soft-tissue prediction, refinement-risk assessment, and remote monitoring. Although AI has significantly improved the efficiency, reproducibility, and standardisation of diagnosis and treatment planning, current evidence supports its use as a clinician-supervised decision-support technology rather than as an autonomous system capable of managing the entire orthodontic-surgical pathway. Conclusions: The integration of clear aligners, digital planning, and AI represents an important step toward a more personalised and efficient workflow, while continued clinical validation and multidisciplinary expertise remain essential for achieving predictable long-term outcomes.

items.summary_ja: 外科矯正プロトコル（SOP）におけるマウスピース型矯正装置（クリアアライナー）と人工知能（AI）の役割を叙述的に考察した通信論文。外科的視点から、クリアアライナーは固定式装置と同等の治療成績を達成しつつ、デジタル治療計画により治療期間の予測可能性を向上させる一方、手術タイミング、術中アンカレッジ、術後歯槽安定化、横径管理、保定など歯科矯正医と顎顔面外科医の緊密な連携を要する臨床的側面の管理が求められる。また、AIの応用として自動頭部X線計測解析、画像セグメンテーション、治療判断支援、バーチャル患者構築、クリアアライナーセットアップ、軟組織予測、リファインメントリスク評価、リモートモニタリングを概説し、AIは自律システムではなく臨床医監督下の判断支援技術として位置づけるべきと結論している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 外科矯正プロトコルにおいてクリアアライナーは固定式装置と同等の治療成績を達成し、デジタル治療計画により治療期間の予測可能性を高める。AIは診断・治療計画の効率性・再現性・標準化を向上させるが、臨床医監督下の判断支援技術として用いるべきであり、矯正外科経路全体を自律的に管理するシステムではない。
items.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：デジタル治療計画により治療期間の予測可能性が向上する。planned-vs-achieved：クリアアライナーは固定式装置と同等の治療成績を達成する。リファインメント：リファインメントリスク評価がAI応用として言及されている。ワークフロー：クリアアライナー、デジタル計画、AIの統合によりより個別化かつ効率的なワークフローへの移行が示唆される。安全性：手術タイミング、術中アンカレッジ、術後歯槽安定化、横径管理、保定などの臨床的側面の慎重な管理が求められる。

items.title: Micronuclei and cytomorphometric alterations in fixed (metal/ceramic) and removable orthodontic appliances: a prospective exploratory comparative study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Orthodontic appliances may induce mechanical and biochemical stress on the oral mucosa, potentially leading to early cytological alterations.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate and compare the cytomorphometric parameters and micronuclei (MN) frequency in fixed metal, ceramic, and removable orthodontic appliances in adolescents at 1 and 6 weeks after appliance placement.
METHODS: This prospective exploratory comparative study was conducted on 30 adolescents divided into three groups: metal, ceramic, and removable orthodontic appliance (n = 10 each). Exfoliative cytology using Papanicolaou staining was performed at two experimental sites (S1, S2) and one non-contact intraoral comparison site (S3) at 1 week (T1) and 6 weeks (T2). No true pre-treatment baseline (T0) was available. Intergroup comparisons were made using Kruskal-Wallis, and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test was used for within-group comparisons.
RESULTS: Intergroup comparison showed no significant differences for cytoplasmic (C ) area and nuclear (N) area, and N: C ratio across most comparisons (p > 0.05) (p = 0.096-0.995; η² = 0.0003-0.16). A difference was noted only for MN frequency at the S1T1 (p = 0.04; η²=0.22). The principal findings were derived from intragroup T1-to-T2 comparisons. In the fixed metal appliance group, MN (p ≤ 0.028) and N: C ratio (p = 0.002) increased significantly across all sites(S1, S2, S3), with strong effect sizes. The ceramic appliance group showed limited, site-specific changes, with micronucleus frequency significantly increased at S1 (p = 0.014), while the N: C ratio (p = 0.037) and nuclear area (p = 0.002) showed significant changes at S3. The removable appliance group showed a significant increase in MN frequency, N:C ratio, and cytoplasmic area across selected sites, with strong effect sizes.
CONCLUSIONS: Within the limitations of this small exploratory study, early post-placement cytological alterations were observed in the oral mucosa during orthodontic treatment, particularly in MN frequency and N: C ratio. However, these findings should be interpreted cautiously due to lack of true pre-treatment baseline. Also, most intergroup comparisons were non-significant. MN frequency and N: C ratio may indicate promising research indicators of cytological alterations suggestive of cytogenetic stress, especially in the fixed metal and removable appliance groups. Nevertheless, there is need for larger longitudinal studies with true baseline assessment before stronger conclusions can be drawn.
items.authors: Kapoor Priyanka, Chowdhry Aman, Shrivastava Priyanshu Kumar, Uppal Simran, Bhawal Ujjal K, Dave Aparna, Natarajan Srikant
items.summary_ja: 固定式金属・セラミック・可撤式矯正装置の3群（各n=10、計30名の青少年）を対象に、装置装着後1週（T1）と6週（T2）における口腔粘膜の細胞形態計測パラメータ（細胞質面積、核面積、N:C比）および微小核（MN）頻度を比較した前向き探索的比較研究。Papanicolaou染色による剥離細胞診を2つの接触部位（S1, S2）と1つの非接触対照部位（S3）で実施。真の処置前ベースライン（T0）は得られていない。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 装置装着後早期に口腔粘膜の細胞学的変化（特にMN頻度とN:C比の増加）が観察されたが、固定式金属群と可撤式群で顕著であった。ただし真のベースライン欠如と小規模サンプルのため、結果は慎重に解釈すべきであり、より大規模な縦断研究が必要と結論されている。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：矯正装置の種類（金属・セラミック・可撤式）による口腔粘膜への細胞遺伝学的ストレスの差異が示唆されており、治療計画における装置選択時の安全性評価の参考情報となり得る。特に固定式金属装置と可撤式装置でMN頻度とN:C比の有意な増加が認められた点は、装置の生体適合性に関する安全性検討の文脈で関連する。

items.endpoints_ja: 細胞形態計測パラメータ（細胞質面積、核面積、N:C比）および微小核（MN）頻度
items.endpoint_results_ja: 群間比較：細胞質面積・核面積・N:C比に有意差なし（p > 0.05、p = 0.096-0.995、η² = 0.0003-0.16）。MN頻度はS1T1のみ有意差（p = 0.04、η² = 0.22）。群内T1→T2比較：固定式金属群でMN（p ≤ 0.028）とN:C比（p = 0.002）が全部位（S1, S2, S3）で有意増加。セラミック群でMN頻度がS1で有意増加（p = 0.014）、N:C比（p = 0.037）と核面積（p = 0.002）がS3で有意変化。可撤式群でMN頻度・N:C比・細胞質面積が選択部位で有意増加。

items.title: A multivariable model for treatment duration in nonextraction clear aligner therapy.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The objective of this study was to evaluate the associations between pretreatment dentoalveolar characteristics and treatment duration in nonextraction clear aligner therapy (CAT).
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 296 patients treated with nonextraction CAT. Pretreatment variables were extracted from Invisalign ClinCheck (Align Technology, Santa Clara, Calif) digital treatment planning software and included deviations in overjet and overbite from a 3 mm reference, arch irregularities, midline deviation, and posterior crossbite. Treatment duration was defined as the time from initial aligner delivery to the completion of all refinement stages. Multivariable linear regression analysis was performed to evaluate the associations between pretreatment characteristics and treatment duration. Internal validation was performed using bootstrap resampling (5000 iterations).
RESULTS: The 11 pretreatment variables collectively explained 32.8% of the variability in treatment duration (R2 = 0.328; adjusted R2 = 0.302). Overbite showed the strongest association with treatment duration, followed by mandibular crowding, midline deviation, and posterior crossbite (P <0.001). Each 1 mm increase in overbite and overjet was associated with increases of approximately 41 and 15 days in treatment duration, respectively. The presence of posterior crossbite was associated with an approximately 89-day increase. Bootstrap analysis demonstrated the stability of the regression estimates.
CONCLUSIONS: Pretreatment dentoalveolar characteristics were significantly associated with treatment duration in nonextraction CAT. Although several baseline characteristics independently contributed to treatment duration, the model explained approximately one-third of its variability, highlighting the influence of biological, behavioral, and treatment-related factors beyond pretreatment records.

items.summary_ja: 非抜歯型クリアアライナー治療（CAT）における治療期間と治療前の歯顎所見との関連を評価した後ろ向きコホート研究。Invisalign ClinCheckから治療前変数（オーバージェット・オーバーバイトの3mm基準からの偏差、アーチ不整、中线偏差、後方交叉咬合）を抽出し、多変量線形回帰分析を行った。治療期間は初回アライナー交付から全リファインメント段階完了までの期間として定義した。ブートストラップ再サンプリング（5000反復）による内部検証も実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 11の治療前変数は治療期間の変動の32.8%を説明した（R2=0.328）。オーバーバイトが最も強い関連を示し、次いで下顎叢生、中线偏差、後方交叉咬合が有意に関連した（P<0.001）。オーバーバイト1mm増加につき約41日、オーバージェット1mm増加につき約15日、後方交叉咬合の存在につき約89日の治療期間延長が関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: 治療計画の品質とワークフローの観点から、治療前の歯顎所見が治療期間に与える影響を定量化しており、ClinCheck上のベースライン所見から治療期間の予測精度を向上させる可能性を示唆する。ただしモデルが変動の約1/3しか説明しないことから、生物学的・行動的・治療関連因子の影響も大きく、計画時の期間設定には注意が必要である。

items.title: Effectiveness and accuracy of clear aligners in treatment of deep bite: a systematic review.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness and accuracy of clear aligners (CA) for dental and skeletal deep bite correction.
METHODS: Searches in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, and grey literature were conducted from inception to May 2024. Studies included all age groups with dental and/or skeletal deep bite treated with CA, with or without control groups, using prospective or retrospective designs. Risk of bias was assessed through Risk Of Bias In Non-randomised Studies-of Interventions ("ROBIN-I").
RESULTS: Out of 829 studies screened, 18 were included. Eight studies assessed CA's effectiveness, eight evaluated CA accuracy, and two examined both. The effectiveness in bite opening ranged from 0.4 mm to 3.8 mm, while the accuracy in deep bite correction varied between 33% and 48.88% across all studies. According to GRADE, the evidence for both CA accuracy and effectiveness in deep bite treatment was rated as low quality due to high risk of bias, indirectness, and imprecision, despite consistent findings across studies.
CONCLUSION: CA can effectively correct mild to moderate dentoalveolar deep bites; however, its efficacy in skeletal cases compared to full-fixed appliance (FFA) remains uncertain. Planned correction of deep bites with CA often falls short of the actual achieved correction, making overcorrection or refinements necessary for achieving the desired treatment outcomes. Due to the limited quality and methodological variability among the studies, recommending CA as a superior modality for deep bite correction remains premature.
CLINICAL RELEVANCE: CA may be effective for dentoalveolar deep bites but often needs adjustments for accuracy and is less effective than FFA for skeletal cases.
REGISTRATION: The review protocol was registered in PROSPERO (#CRD42022334078).
